notes: World heights in arena space. Ring centred on the origin. Animations use frames built from these numbers: the rope frame (rope line at z=0, ring at z>0, outside at z<0) and the corner frame (post at the origin, ropes along +X and +Z, ring at x>0 and z>0). Both frames sit at mat level, so the mat is y=0 and the arena floor is floorHeight - matHeight = -1.16.
